ranking.name: Air temperature near the ground
ranking.sentence: From January 2001 to September 2025, air temperature near the ground in Western Europe changed by +0.22 °C per decade (95% confidence interval +0.10 to +0.34), which is statistically significant (p < 0.001). Over the whole 24.7-year period that is an increase of about 0.54 °C.

ranking.name: Water leaving the land (evapotranspiration)
ranking.sentence: From January 2001 to September 2025, water leaving the land (evapotranspiration) in Western Europe changed by +0.020 mm/day per decade (95% confidence interval +0.009 to +0.032), which is statistically significant (p < 0.001). Over the whole 24.7-year period that is an increase of about 0.050 mm/day.

ranking.name: Water in the topsoil
ranking.sentence: From January 2001 to September 2025, water in the topsoil in Western Europe shows no statistically significant trend (p = 0.26): the estimate is −0.11 kg/m² per decade (95% confidence interval −0.30 to +0.09). This does not mean nothing changed; the data cannot tell a trend this small apart from natural ups and downs.
